propositions: Store must record project-to-repos mapping at the store level in projects.json, separate from per-repo bindings, to prevent diff conflicts when multiple repos sync different project subsets against a shared snapshot.

resolve_project must implement tri-state logic: return legacy_default for absent ticket project field, None for explicit empty string, the project key for a set value, and None when legacy_default itself is empty.
The bridge projects CLI surface must support list, set, and remove sub-verbs with required --repos argument on set, where set on an existing key replaces rather than merges its repos list.

Library (lib_ops.py) and MCP surfaces (_mcp_reads.py for list as READ_ONLY, _mcp_writes.py for set/remove) must operate on the same projects.json record with byte-identical behavior across all three surfaces.
An absent projects.json record must read as a legal empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe until seeded); a malformed record must raise an error rather than degrade.
The pinned help contract in bridge.txt and the parser metavar verb set must both explicitly name the projects verb, and mapping writes must not mutate bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json.
